title: TCE Story-Line Content Manifest
description: Game-agnostic, machine-readable manifest of a story-line content graph, generated from a game's content CSV through its content adapter (src/story-line/content/manifest.ts). Deterministic: sorted nodes/edges and no timestamps, so regeneration from the same content is byte-identical.

gameId.description: Game id of the content adapter that produced the manifest.

storylineIds.description: Sorted story-line ids present in the graph.

nodes.description: Card nodes, sorted by base card id.

edges.description: Option edges, sorted by source, label, candidate index and target.

cycles.description: Detected cycles (a first-class shape); each entry is a sorted cycle path of base card ids.

options.description: Ordered labelled option list; empty for plain incidents.

effect.description: Human-readable effect text shown to the player.

impact.description: Adapter-provided game impact description (e.g. '-50 coins'); empty when the adapter supplies none.

fields.description: Every game-specific column for this card, keyed by CSV column name (raw cell text).

option.description: One labelled player option of a choice node.

label.description: Player-visible option label; also the stable transcript/save token.

successorIds.description: Ordered candidate successor base card ids; empty = terminal chain-end. The engine draws one uniformly at random at resolution time.

effectPolicy.description: Whether the source card's own effect applies when this option is chosen.

to.description: Target base card id (one edge per candidate successor); null when the chain ends.

random.description: True when this edge is one of several random-branch candidates of the same option (candidate set size > 1).

candidateIndex.description: 0-based index of this candidate within its option's ordered candidate set.

cycle.description: True when this edge participates in a cycle.

effectPolicy.description: Whether the source card's own effect applies when this option is chosen.
